definitions.gloss: monthly fee; monthly charge; monthly amount
definitions.explanation: A recurring payment or charge that is billed every month, commonly used for subscriptions, memberships, and services.

examples.japanese: {月額|げつがく}500{円|えん}で{利用|りよう}できる。
examples.english: You can use it for 500 yen per month.

examples.japanese: {月額|げつがく}{料金|りょうきん}はいくらですか？
examples.english: How much is the monthly fee?

examples.japanese: サブスクの{月額|げつがく}を{見直|みなお}したら、{結構|けっこう}{節約|せつやく}できた。
examples.english: When I reviewed my monthly subscription fees, I was able to save quite a bit.

notes:
{月額|げつがく} is commonly used in pricing and subscription contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月額|げつがく}{料金|りょうきん} (monthly fee)
- {月額|げつがく}プラン (monthly plan)
- {月額|げつがく}{制|せい} (monthly billing system)

RELATED TERMS:
- {年額|ねんがく}: annual fee
- {定額|ていがく}: flat rate
- サブスク: subscription
- {日割|ひわ}り: daily rate/proration
